name: Chase Train for Brainrots! 🚂
desc:
Save the Brainrots before the deadly train leaves you behind! 🚂

1. Jump off the moving train! 🚃
2. Run and grab Brainrots! 🏃
3. Run back before the tsunami catches you! 🌊
4. Upgrade your Brainrots and earn even more money! 💸

If you're having fun, remember to hit the thumbs up! 👍
